Enum Class SecurityPositionSeriesRemark

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<SecurityPositionSeriesRemark>
grafioschtrader.types.SecurityPositionSeriesRemark
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SecurityPositionSeriesRemark>, Constable
public enum SecurityPositionSeriesRemark extends Enum<SecurityPositionSeriesRemark>
Notes attached to the series of the security position chart. A missing price or rate never turns into 0; the chart names the cause instead, so a gap can be told apart from a genuine zero. The constant names are the NLS keys shown to the user; the remark is neither persisted nor carries a byte value.

    Enum Constants

    Description
    INTERNAL_TRANSFER
    A security transfer between two accounts of the scope falls into the phase.
    MISSING_FX
    A day lacks the closing rate into the main currency, or a transaction lacks the rate of its date; the affected main currency figures are missing.
    NEGATIVE_UNITS_DAYS
    A day carries negative units of a non-margin security; that day has no value and is left out.
    NO_HOLDING
    The security was never held overnight in the scope; there is no phase and no series.
    NOT_VALUED_DAYS
    A session day of the security's stock exchange before today has units but no price; the day is left out.
    SPIN_OFF
    A spin-off falls into the phase.

  • Enum Constant Details

    • NO_HOLDING

      public static final SecurityPositionSeriesRemark NO_HOLDING
      The security was never held overnight in the scope; there is no phase and no series.

    • NOT_VALUED_DAYS

      public static final SecurityPositionSeriesRemark NOT_VALUED_DAYS
      A session day of the security's stock exchange before today has units but no price; the day is left out.

    • MISSING_FX

      public static final SecurityPositionSeriesRemark MISSING_FX
      A day lacks the closing rate into the main currency, or a transaction lacks the rate of its date; the affected main currency figures are missing.

    • NEGATIVE_UNITS_DAYS

      public static final SecurityPositionSeriesRemark NEGATIVE_UNITS_DAYS
      A day carries negative units of a non-margin security; that day has no value and is left out.

    • INTERNAL_TRANSFER

      public static final SecurityPositionSeriesRemark INTERNAL_TRANSFER
      A security transfer between two accounts of the scope falls into the phase. Invested capital, purchases and the realized result restart at the transfer value there, as GT books the transfer; the drawdown is not affected.

    • SPIN_OFF

      public static final SecurityPositionSeriesRemark SPIN_OFF
      A spin-off falls into the phase. The units stay; invested capital moves to the new shares at its historical cost and main currency amount without a realized result, and the market value of the new shares leaves the parent as one outflow.
